name: Cougar-EGY HDMI 2.1 3M Cable
shortDescription: Cougar-EGY Ultra High Speed HDMI 2.1 3M Cable (Native 48Gbps Bandwidth / HDMI 2.1V Standard with Ethernet / Supports 4K@144Hz, 2K@240Hz & 8K@60Hz Uncompressed / Advanced Digital Audio Pass-Through / Durable Shielding
descriptionHtml:
Cougar-EGY Ultra High Speed HDMI 2.1 3M Cable (Native 48Gbps Bandwidth / HDMI 2.1V Standard with Ethernet / Supports 4K@144Hz, 2K@240Hz & 8K@60Hz Uncompressed / Advanced Digital Audio Pass-Through / Durable Shielding / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Unlock the full performance of your modern gaming consoles and PC hardware with the Cougar-EGY HDMI 2.1 3M Cable, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Delivering native 48Gbps ultra-high bandwidth without relying on Display Stream Compression (DSC), this high-performance HDMI cable seamlessly outputs smooth uncompressed 4K visuals up to 144Hz at 10-bit color, high-frame-rate 1440p and 1080p up to 240Hz, and ultra-high-resolution 8K video output alongside crystal-clear digital audio.
